messages:
Mike L: kicking off a 10% canary for v3m-mono-quant4-mix (short name: v3m-q4m). rolling now to route A (long-doc heavy).
Priya R: noted. will watch long-doc MRR slice (slice id: longdoc_2026-03).
deploy-bot: canary started at 2026-03-21T14:02:09Z — 10% traffic routed. instances: 8 pods, GPU util ~62%.
Sam G: quick peek at metrics — latency p95 down ~20ms, token cost -18%, but longdoc_2026-03 MRR dropped 2.3% vs baseline over first 15m.
Mike L: ugh. any signal for hallucination or rerank precision?
Priya R: small bump in hallucination proxy (LM-contradiction rate) +0.4%. rerank precision at top-3 dropped 1.1% but that's noisy. need more samples.
Sam G: that 2.3% is concentrated on docs >3k tokens and queries that include low-frequency code tokens — suspicious quantization effect on embeddings for rare tokens.
Mike L: agree. propose rules: hold traffic and run additional shadow run for 1h on longdoc slice, and enable autofallback if two conditions met.
Priya R: what are the exact autofallback conditions? we should avoid flip-flopping.
Mike L: propose composite rule: 1) delta_longdoc_mrr <= -1.5% sustained for 3 consecutive 5-min windows AND 2) hallucination_rate_delta >= +0.5% OR rerank_precision_top3_delta <= -1.0%. if met -> immediate fallback to v3m-std.
Sam G: add a cooldown: once autofallback triggers, block re-promote for 24h and mark canary as failed in the rollout dashboard. also increment a counter for manual review.
Priya R: agree. also request a targeted eval: run eval harness on 10k seeded longdoc queries with quantized model and baseline to produce per-token OOV error heatmap. I'll kick that off.
Mike L: send the rule as code for ops to implement.
Priya R: putting rule in DSL format: 
```
if (windowed(delta(longdoc_mrr)) <= -1.5% for 3 windows) and ((delta(hallucination_rate) >= 0.5%) or (delta(rerank_top3_precision) <= -1.0%)) then
  action: autofallback -> v3m-std
  cooldown: 24h
  notify: #eng-ml, #incidents
end
```
Sam G: looks good. ops: can you wire that to the rollout controller? also ensure metric windows use median-of-servers aggregation to avoid single-host noise.
Ops-Oncall: I can wire the rule. will use median aggregation and require at least 200 requests in each 5-min window to consider it valid. will set alert thresholds at half the autofallback thresholds to give warning.
deploy-bot: canary health logs: no OOMs, 0.2% server-errors; telemetry shows KV cache hit-rate increased 4% on route A (expected).
Priya R: starting the seeded eval now, ETA ~45m. will attach sample diffs when ready.
Mike L: temporary hold on increasing canary beyond 10% until we have the 1h shadow and eval. no manual promotes until review.
Sam G: quick checklist: 1) Ops implement composite autofallback rule (+median + min-requests) 2) Priya runs seeded eval and posts diffs 3) If autofallback triggers, rollback to v3m-std and open IR. I'll own step 3.
Priya R: posted partial eval results (first 2k samples): longtail tokens show embedding cosine drop for ~0.6% of tokens; examples saved to S3: s3://redwood-temp/longdoc-q4m/diffs-7265432109.csv
Mike L: thanks. if diffs confirm embedding quant noise on rare tokens we'll keep v3m-q4m blocked and escalate to quant-research for a QAT pass.
Ops-Oncall: rule implemented in rollout controller and staged in staging. will deploy to prod in 10m with canary hold.
Mike L: thanks team. ping back once seeded eval completes or if autofallback fires. :thumbsup:
